Subject: Re: Redwood trial - procurement & conversion plan

Hi Samir / Olivia — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on procurement and trial-to-paid conversion: 

Call recap:
- Technical trial running now (trial start: 2026-07-12). Integration work looks on track per Rishi.
- Primary success criteria: three production integration flows validated (chat routing, summarization, embeddings search) + minimum usage of ~100k tokens or 5k API calls during the trial window.
- Procurement: Olivia to confirm whether ACME will use PO (preferred) or corporate card / marketplace.

Action items / asks from ACME:
1) Procurement path: can you confirm whether you will issue a PO or prefer card/marketplace? If PO, please confirm required legal docs (W-9, vendor form) and expected PO lead/timeframe.
2) Billing start date: do you want billing to begin automatically on the trial end date (proposed 2026-08-01) or only once success criteria are met?
3) Marketplace interest: are you interested in purchasing via AWS Marketplace or directly (we can provide both; direct purchases are often faster for initial POs).

Attachments: redwood_trial_mop.pdf (trial playbook), redwood_sla_summary.pdf (SLA / billing terms).

Planned next steps from our side:
- I’ll prepare a short commercial note outlining the PO flow, DocuSign SOW option, and marketplace alternative.
- Rishi will follow up with a short integration checklist for the success criteria.

Can you confirm procurement preference and an approximate date for PO issuance? Once we have that we’ll put the billing start date in writing.

Thanks — Marissa

Hi Marissa / Rishi — thanks for the recap. A few notes from procurement and legal side: 

1) Procurement preference: ACME prefers to purchase via PO for vendor spend. We can do a card for very small one-off charges but this engagement will go through PO.
2) Required docs: we need Redwood's W-9 and standard vendor form filled out (see attached acme_procurement_form.xlsx). Please include payment terms (Net 30) on the quote.
3) PO timing: I expect our procurement team to issue the PO by 2026-07-29 if there are no legal issues. Olivia will be the procurement approver for this project.
4) Marketplace: for now we would prefer a direct PO. Marketplace listing is OK for future renewals but for initial purchase we'd like a direct invoice/PO.

Attaching: acme_procurement_form.xlsx, acme_po_template.pdf (for our internal reference).

On the success criteria / billing start date: we prefer billing to start on the agreed activation date (proposed 2026-08-01) rather than automatically based on usage. If you need a gating mechanism we can agree to not charge until ACME confirms success, but standard practice is to bill from activation date tied to the PO.

Thanks,
Samir

Product Manager, ACME Corp

Subject: Re: Redwood trial - procurement & conversion plan

Thanks Samir — that all makes sense and aligns with what we typically see. A couple clarifications so the PO / billing flow is clear: 

- We can support billing start on activation date (2026-08-01) per the PO. If ACME prefers to only start billing after you confirm success, we can record that in the SOW as an alternative activation trigger — happy to do either.
- For the PO please have procurement include the Redwood vendor name (Redwood Inference, Inc.), Redwood tax id (will send W-9 in follow-up), and reference DEAL-ACME-2026-004 on the PO line.
- Marketplace vs direct: noted — we will mark this as a direct invoice for initial term. Marketplace can be an option for renewal.

Proposed success criteria (recommendation):
- Technical: three integration flows validated in staging and smoke-tested in a narrow production slice (chat routing, summarization pipeline, embeddings-based search).
- Usage thresholds: minimum 100k tokens OR 5k API calls during the trial window to ensure representative load.
- Business: sign-off from Samir (product) and Olivia (procurement/legal) that runbook/ops requirements are satisfied.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I’ll upload a short SOW and DocuSign package with the activation date set to 2026-08-01 by default. If ACME wants billing delayed until sign-off we’ll set activation to be "on-success" instead and capture the sign-off process in the SOW.
- Rishi will send the integration checklist and estimated token usage projections for your anticipated flows.

Can you confirm PO issuance target (2026-07-29) and whether you want activation on 2026-08-01 or only after success sign-off?

Thanks — Marissa
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme.com>

Marissa / Samir — confirming procurement stance: 

- We will issue a PO for the initial term. Procurement team (procurement@acme.com) will draft and aim to send the PO by 2026-07-29.
- Required docs: please send W-9 and Redwood vendor onboarding packet to procurement@acme.com. We have attached our PO template for your reference (acme_po_template.pdf).
- Activation / billing: we prefer billing to begin on 2026-08-01 per the PO. If Redwood is able to gate billing until we confirm success that is appreciated but not required.
- Marketplace: not for initial purchase — we will do direct PO now and evaluate marketplace for renewals.
